title: New Book Features Concept Art & Designs From ‘KPop Demon Hunters’: Here’s Where to Buy It Online
summary: Available for preorder, the new art book is a must for fans and arrives Sept. 8.
contentText:

Since its release in June 2025, KPop Demon Hunters has been a gigantic pop-culture phenomenon that’s still resinating with audiences one year later. In fact, the movie has inspired a wide range of toys, merch and apparel , board games and even an upcoming 4K Blu-ray release from the Criterion Collection . And now, there’s a new book that shows off the artwork from the Academy Award-winning film .

On sale for $26.10 (regularly $28) on Amazon, The Art of KPop Demon Hunters: Platinum Edition is a new book that features concept art, in-progress stills, final designs and other art pieces created during the production of the hit Netflix animated musical . It has more than 500 pieces from KPop Demon Hunters , as well as commentary from directors Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans, and other writers, artists and animators.

The book is ready for preorder right now, with release set for Tuesday, Sept. 8.

Meanwhile, The Art of KPop Demon Hunters: Platinum Edition is also available as a Kindle ebook. It’s less expensive than the physical hardcover book, as it’s priced at $14.99. The ebook version comes out on Tuesday, Sept. 8. If you preorder now, it will be delivered digitally to your Kindle or Kindle mobile app upon release.

In the meantime, the art book is on sale for $24.50 (regularly $28) on Amazon. It’s available for preorder and comes out on Tuesday, Sept. 8.

Additionally, the art book is available for preorder at BookShop.org for $37.28 (regularly $40) , while The Art of KPop Demon Hunters: Platinum Edition can be preordered at Barnes & Noble priced at $35 (regularly $40) .
